name: Greens Chute-Missouri River
places: Big Muddy National Fish And Wildlife Refuge
Big Muddy National Fish And Wildlife Refuge
about: Greens Chute-Missouri River drains about 23 square miles, 48% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 670 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 440 feet at its lowest. Its main stream is Bonhomme Creek. St. Charles County communities here include Weldon Spring and Weldon Spring Heights. Downstream, its water passes through the Duckett Creek-Missouri River, Cowmire Creek-Missouri River and Outlet Missouri River watersheds on its way down the Missouri River, which joins the Mississippi River at the east end of St. Charles County.
